name: independent-labels
title: Independent Fashion Labels: verified brands and products
description: Brand names or websites in; verified independent fashion labels and their in-stock products out. Finds each label's own Shopify store and checks it's a real, small, established label, not a marketplace, chain, reseller or drop-shipper. Public catalogs only.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Brand names or websites, e.g. "Batul The Collection" or "velathelabel.com". A website is the most reliable.

query.title: Looking for
query.description: Optional: what to match, e.g. "satin slip skirt". A named item type (dress, jacket...) only matches that type. Blank returns each label's in-stock products.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Items above this price (in the shop's currency) are dropped.

itemsPerBrand.title: Items per brand
itemsPerBrand.description: Most products returned per brand, best matches first.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified labels only
verifiedOnly.description: Skip products from stores that fail a check (the OUTPUT record lists every brand's checks either way).
